_comment: Minimal pairs that differ only by explicit negation. Each pair is queried twice: once affirmatively (expects 'pos'), once negated (expects 'neg'). Antonym pairs (enabled/disabled) are deliberately excluded: they test vocabulary, not negation.

pairs.pos: WAL journal mode is enabled on the production database.
pairs.neg: WAL journal mode is not enabled on the production database.
pairs.q_pos: Is WAL journal mode enabled on the production database?
pairs.q_neg: Which database does not have WAL journal mode enabled?

pairs.pos: The HTTP server owns the Cloudflare sync.
pairs.neg: The HTTP server does not own the Cloudflare sync.
pairs.q_pos: Who owns the Cloudflare sync? The HTTP server does.
pairs.q_neg: The HTTP server does not own the Cloudflare sync, right?

distractors: The dashboard uses a dark theme toggle stored per browser.
LoCoMo has ten conversations and about 1,700 questions.
The embedding model is all-MiniLM-L6-v2 with 384 dimensions.
Consolidation runs on a schedule managed by APScheduler.
The landing page deploys to Cloudflare Pages on every merge.
Chunking uses 1000 characters with a 200 character overlap.
The triage digest runs daily from launchd.
Relationship inference uses a confidence threshold of 0.6.
Tags with the __test__ marker are cleaned up after test runs.
The release workflow publishes to PyPI and Docker Hub.
Greptile reviews every pull request automatically.
The OpenCode client has its own inbox implementation.
Delta sync runs every fifteen minutes on the Mac.
The site test count tile shows the number of collected tests.
